market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to consolidate higher near-term on bank strength and easing oil/yields, but AUD weakness and Fed uncertainty cap upside. RBA hike risk and IMF fiscal pressure create headwinds. Volatility elevated around Middle East oil developments.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural tailwinds from WA mining pipeline, data centre capex, and energy transition support 6-12 month ASX trajectory. Consumer weakness and state debt costs are offsetting risks. RBA policy normalisation and AUD stabilisation key to sustained rally.
